svg.desc: Inside the prediction service: a caller sends JSON to the FastAPI app, whose middleware logs and times the request and whose Pydantic contract rejects bad input with 422. The model holder keeps the pipeline loaded from the registry, and logs and metrics record latency and recent inputs.
